correctness.rationale: IFC forces every R-target to be minimal. With a minimal target, FC2 is equivalent to downward closure of its predecessor fiber. The converse construction satisfies IFC and FC2 immediately. The exact finite count is then the product of independent downset choices. Substitution into the published box and diamond semantics yields the claimed minimal-trace formulas. Exhaustive finite checks confirm all steps.

value.rationale: IFS frames are a new structural ingredient in the modal constructive-quantum embedding theorem. The accepted result reduces their finite construction from arbitrary relation search to independent downset choices at minimal worlds, gives an exact census, and shows that both primitive modalities only inspect the minimal trace of their downset argument. These are reusable structural facts for finite-model exploration of the new semantics.
